name: SELECT * on Wide Table
sql: SELECT * FROM customers;

name: Unbounded Orders Scan
sql: SELECT order_id, total_amount FROM orders;

name: Non-Sargable YEAR() Function Filter
sql: SELECT * FROM orders WHERE strftime('%Y', order_date) = '2024';

name: Filter on Unindexed Column (shipping_city)
sql: SELECT order_id, total_amount FROM orders WHERE shipping_city = 'Chicago';

name: Leading Wildcard in LIKE Condition
sql: SELECT customer_id, first_name, email FROM customers WHERE email LIKE '%@example.com';

name: Redundant DISTINCT with GROUP BY
sql: SELECT DISTINCT status, COUNT(*) FROM orders GROUP BY status;

name: Cartesian Product Missing Join Condition
sql: SELECT customers.first_name, orders.order_id FROM customers, orders;

name: Unbounded ORDER BY on Large Table
sql: SELECT order_id, total_amount FROM orders ORDER BY total_amount DESC;

name: Multiple OR Equality Predicates
sql: SELECT product_id, name, price FROM products WHERE category = 'Electronics' OR category = 'Books' OR category = 'Clothing';

name: Join with Indexed Customer ID (Good Query)
sql: SELECT o.order_id, o.order_date, c.first_name, c.email FROM orders o JOIN customers c ON o.customer_id = c.customer_id WHERE o.customer_id = 42;

name: Filter on Unindexed Salary in Employees
sql: SELECT employee_id, first_name, salary FROM employees WHERE salary > 120000;

name: Composite Index Opportunity (status + order_date)
sql: SELECT order_id, customer_id, total_amount FROM orders WHERE status = 'delivered' ORDER BY order_date DESC LIMIT 50;

name: SELECT * with Multi-Table Joins
sql: SELECT * FROM orders o JOIN order_items oi ON o.order_id = oi.order_id JOIN products p ON oi.product_id = p.product_id WHERE o.order_id = 100;

name: Already Optimal Filtered Aggregation
sql: SELECT status, COUNT(*), SUM(total_amount) FROM orders WHERE order_date >= '2024-01-01' GROUP BY status;

name: Non-Sargable strftime on Created Date
sql: SELECT customer_id, first_name, email FROM customers WHERE strftime('%Y', created_at) = '2023';

name: Full Scan on Products Stock Filter
sql: SELECT product_id, name, stock_quantity FROM products WHERE stock_quantity < 10;

name: Multi-Join on Department Location
sql: SELECT e.first_name, e.last_name, d.name, d.location FROM employees e JOIN departments d ON e.department_id = d.department_id WHERE d.location = 'Building A, Floor 3';

name: Correlated Order Items Aggregation
sql: SELECT o.order_id, o.total_amount, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM order_items oi WHERE oi.order_id = o.order_id) as item_count FROM orders o WHERE o.customer_id = 10;

name: Filter on Unindexed Country in Suppliers
sql: SELECT supplier_id, name, contact_email FROM suppliers WHERE country = 'Germany';

name: Complex Multi-Issue Query (SELECT *, Wildcard, Sort)
sql: SELECT * FROM customers WHERE email LIKE '%@gmail.com' ORDER BY city;
